metadata.title: ExamFlow — Exams Generator
metadata.description: Premium practice exam platform for CISSP, CC, SSCP, CCSP, and CGRC certifications.

hero.description: An adaptive study engine that identifies your weak areas, eliminates wasted repetition, and builds the confidence you need to pass.

sarah.name: Sarah Mitchell
sarah.quote: ExamFlow showed me exactly which domains I was weakest in. I went from 58% to passing in three weeks.

daniel.quote: The spaced-review mode alone is worth it. I retain so much more compared to just re-reading notes.

marcus.name: Marcus Johnson
marcus.quote: Finally a platform that doesn't just quiz me — it teaches me where I'm failing and why.

problem.heading: Traditional study is broken
problem.subheading: Most people study harder when they should study smarter. Here is the difference.
oldWays: No idea what you don't know

benefits.heading: Everything changes when studying has direction
benefits.subheading: Stop burning hours on material you already know. Focus on the gaps that matter.

items.title: Learn faster
items.description: Adaptive algorithms surface the right questions at the right time, eliminating wasted repetition on material you already know.

items.title: Find your blind spots
items.description: Domain-level performance tracking identifies exactly where your knowledge breaks down — before the exam does.

items.title: Retain knowledge longer
items.description: Spaced review schedules questions based on memory decay curves, reinforcing concepts right before you forget them.

items.title: Build exam confidence
items.description: Track your scores over time. Watch your weak domains become strong ones. Walk into the exam knowing you are ready.

howItWorks.heading: Three steps. Zero friction.
howItWorks.subheading: Get from signup to meaningful practice in under two minutes.

steps.title: Choose what to study
steps.description: Select your certification and configure domain focus, difficulty, and question count.

steps.title: Practice intelligently
steps.description: Our engine adapts to your performance — targeting weak areas, avoiding repeats, and mixing difficulty levels.

steps.title: Track your mastery
steps.description: See per-domain accuracy, streak progress, and score trends. Know when you are ready.

depth.heading: Under the hood
depth.description: This is not a flashcard app. It is a performance engine built on real learning science.

features.title: Intelligent Question Engine
features.description: Six exam modes — from practice to spaced review. The engine weighs recency, accuracy, and domain coverage to build the optimal question set for each session.

features.title: Mastery Tracking
features.description: Per-question attempt history with memory-decay modeling. Every answer updates your performance summary atomically — no stale data, no guessing.

features.title: Adaptive Difficulty
features.description: Real-mix mode mirrors actual exam distributions. Weak-domain mode concentrates 70% of questions on your lowest-scoring areas. You study what matters.

features.title: Performance Analytics
features.description: Domain accuracy breakdowns, score history, streak tracking, and daily goals. Everything you need to make data-driven study decisions.

cta.subheading: Join thousands of certification candidates studying with precision.

cancel.a: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. You'll keep Pro access until the end of your billing period.

trialEnd.q: What happens when my trial ends?
trialEnd.a: You'll be charged automatically when your trial ends. You can cancel anytime before the trial ends to avoid being charged.

switchPlan.q: Can I switch from monthly to annual?
switchPlan.a: Yes! You can switch at any time from your billing portal. When switching to annual, you'll be credited for any unused time on your monthly plan.

refunds.a: Contact our support team within 7 days of purchase for a full refund. No questions asked.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards through Stripe. Apple Pay and Google Pay are also supported.

footer.secure: Payments processed securely by Stripe. Your card information is never stored on our servers.
